messages:
nina: Atlas wants a perf POC for tokenization + fraud-score call. Targets: steady 600 qps for 15m, 2 microbursts 12k qps 6s each, p95 <180ms, p99 <320ms. Need cost uplift and short security note. who owns?

arjun: I'll own runbook and sizing. Need an ops lead for execution. Prefer Wed 22:00 UTC.

maria: I can run it. Plan: warm 10m@250qps, steady 15m@600qps, bursts 2x6s@12k spaced 90s. Stub downstream DB, enable KV prefix cache, use quantized model.

infra-bot: reserved-pool "atlas-poc-01" provisioned at 4891010120

arjun: autoscale: min_shards=2, max_shards=10, scale_step=+3, target_cpu=65%. burst_policy=instant. cap per-shard throughput=2k qps.

sam (atlas): We require KMS and audit logs. Wed 22:00 UTC OK. We'll provide stub dataset.

billing: need 1-line cost delta for bursts vs steady for sales deck.

maria: quick loadgen: `rl-load --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/tokenize --qps 12000 --duration 6s --shape bursts,count=2,spacing=90s` and `rl-load --qps 600 --duration 15m`

arjun: measurement: capture p50/p95/p99, token decode timing, scale events, and GPU/CPU. We'll upload run artifacts to drive.

nina: owners: runbook/sizing=arjun, exec=maria, sec=nina. I'll send Atlas the brief security note after we confirm KMS. Final runbook by EOD.
